title: HECM Payment Computation: New Monthly Scheduled Payment from the Committed Line
content:
**Formal statement.** On a Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) change onto monthly scheduled payments, the new scheduled payment is the payment the committed amount buys less the withholdings, each withholding worked out on its own and added to the withholdings, floored at 0.00, with the only roundings those stated for a withholding itself and the final rounding of the new scheduled payment, half up to the cent. It is 0.00 for a loan outside the scope of this processing, that is a loan whose current plan pays a scheduled payment.

**Payment the committed amount buys.** The committed amount multiplied by the payment rate, divided by the following: one plus the payment rate, multiplied by one less one plus the payment rate raised to the power of minus the payment count. Every payment is treated as made at the start of its month, the first payment falls in the month after the handling month, and there is none when the payment count is 0.

**Quantities.** A loan carries at most one submitted payout plan change request at a time.

- *Committed amount:* the requested amount on that request for the HECM Modified Tenure Plan or HECM Modified Term Plan; the whole available line for the HECM Tenure Payment Plan or HECM Term Payment Plan.
- *Payment rate:* one twelfth of the sum of the expected rate and the plan's annual mortgage insurance premium rate, divided by 100.
- *Payment count:* twelve times the difference between 100 years — the tenure age horizon the tenure-based plans carry — and the borrower's age for a tenure-based plan (HECM Tenure Payment Plan or HECM Modified Tenure Plan), and the requested term in months for any other plan.
- *Borrower's age:* the youngest borrower's age at closing plus the whole years from the closing date to the handling date. Whole calendar months between two dates are complete on the later month's day with the same day number as the earlier date, or on the first day of the following month when that month has no such day number, and whole years are twelve whole months.
- *Withholdings:* 0.00.

**Other changes.** Where a new scheduled payment is set on a change this processing does not cover, it is the committed amount multiplied by the monthly rate, divided by one plus the monthly rate multiplied by one less one plus the monthly rate raised to the power of minus the payment count, rounded half up to the cent; the payment count is the requested term for a term-based plan and, for a tenure-based plan, twelve times the difference between the tenure age horizon and the age in whole years, on the first day of the month the change takes effect, of the youngest borrower or eligible non-borrowing spouse on the loan.

**Worked figures (hypothetical inputs; expected rate 5.000 percent, premium rate 0.50 percent).**

| Request | Committed | Payment count | New scheduled payment |
|---|---|---|---|
| Modified Term, 120 months, requested amount 30000.00 | 30000.00 | 120 | 324.09 |
| Modified Tenure, borrower aged 80 | 50000.00 | 240 | 342.37 |
